extracted.intended_audience: nonprofit professionals, funders, donors, researchers, and data/technology partners
extracted.subtask_description: Using Candid to identify and connect with appropriate funders, research nonprofits (by mission, program, location, and finances), claim and present organization profiles, and integrate nonprofit/grants data into workflows via APIs or custom datasets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Up-to-date grant and nonprofit data (beyond 990s)
rubrics_metrics.description: Find more up-to-date grant and nonprofit data than on 990s
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Candid emphasizes that its search provides more current information than relying solely on IRS Form 990 filings, implying recency and ongoing updates are a key quality criterion when researching nonprofits and grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search by mission, programs, and location
rubrics_metrics.description: Research nonprofits based on mission, programs, and location
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should filter and discover organizations by substantive aspects (what they do) and geography to get robust nonprofit data that fuels decision making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explore current financial overviews and trends
rubrics_metrics.description: Explore current financial overviews and trends
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The platform provides financial summaries and trend information to support evaluations of organizational finances and funding flows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify key decision makers and look up nonprofit information
rubrics_metrics.description: Look up nonprofit information and identify key decision makers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond organizational facts, the ability to find contacts/decision-makers is presented as a criterion for actionable funder outreach and relationship-building.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claim and present an organization profile to attract funders
rubrics_metrics.description: Claim your profile — Tell your story and share your impact to attract funders quickly and easily.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Actively managing/claiming an org profile is framed as a best practice to present impact, increase discoverability, and accelerate funder connections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Real-time data updates via APIs
rubrics_metrics.description: Get real-time data updates through our APIs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For programmatic consumers, receiving live updates is a quality and operational requirement to keep downstream systems current.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seamless integration into workstreams
rubrics_metrics.description: Seamlessly integrate nonprofit information into workstreams
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data should be usable within existing processes and tools — integration capability (APIs, connectors) is a criterion of value for technical users and solution providers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customized nonprofit datasets on request
rubrics_metrics.description: Request nonprofit data sets customized to your needs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ability to procure bespoke, shaped datasets is offered as a requirement for users with specialized analytic or operational needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standardized, organized, enhanced, and tagged data for discoverability
rubrics_metrics.description: Standardized, organized, enhanced, and tagged for optimal discoverability and analysis
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data quality includes normalization, enrichment, and metadata/tagging to support searching, filtering, and analytic workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Breadth and scale of coverage as a quality metric
rubrics_metrics.description: 1.9M Organization profiles; 3M Annual grant transactions; $180B Annual grant dollars
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coverage statistics (number of profiles, transactions, and dollar volumes) are presented as indicators of comprehensiveness and utility for sector-wide analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data should enable a holistic view across subjects and actors
rubrics_metrics.description: Analysts, advocates, and philanthropists rely on Candid for nonprofit information and data that captures the work of the social sector, enabling a holistic view of activity across a wide array of subjects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The underlying criterion is that data must support cross-topic, cross-actor analysis to inform decisions, policy, advocacy, and philanthropy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience-specific use cases (match tool to user need)
rubrics_metrics.description: Explore more, just for you — Nonprofits: Find grant funding for your mission. Funders & donors: Discover nonprofits to support. Business & financial services: Identify and support your nonprofit clients. Technical solution providers: Power your solution with nonprofit and grants data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The platform is positioned to meet distinct user goals; selecting data/tools should be guided by the user's role and objective (fund-seeking, grantmaking, client support, or product integration).
